text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, at the training track...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, I know you. Ehehe, did you hear
me just
now?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Since you're here, lemme rant! You know

McQueen, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She told me the trick to long-distance
running is
keeping a steady pace, then
suggested I try doing
tempo runs.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But running at a set pace is such a drag! It feels SO much better to run as fast as I can!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you get it! The best type of
training really
is the one that motivates
you the most!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
All right! Time to sprint a lap at top
speed! Here
comes the mighty Teio!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems that she's able to focus much
better on
her running while training the
way she wants.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, I getcha! Maybe you're right! An
all-out
sprint after a paced run, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I bet that'll feel way better than just
running
normally! Hehe, what a great
idea!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna give this tempo running thing
another
chance. Thanks for talking this
out with me!
